issues.title: For some activities, include assets in area in interaction
issues.body:
For interactions, we include the assets assigned in both activities.

But, for some activities, we should include all assets in the geometry. Well, all assets for a polygon, ~~plus assets within a buffered region for a point/line~~ (no, just for polygon).

No, hold on. This is just for `events`.  It's an `event` when we provide the adjudicator with details of all assets physically in that area.

So, there will be these changes:
- flag in activity description
- set flag in the `activity generator` code
- observe flag in `adjudication messages list`:  check the activities (may only be one), and if they require all assets in area, do a search, and include the data in the adjudication
- note: if the activity includes multiple polygons, it's just the second one that we do this for

Part of this is in the activities spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/124oknSmwjnlDXIhcIpBfngMQqtK8nTSOfdmV6VfmY3Y/edit#gid=0
